title: Beets Tagine
description: A traditional North African stew made with beets, lovely and crunchy ingredients. Perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: syrian spices
ingredients.notes: a mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chopped beets, salt, and syrian spices. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and stir to combine. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Transfer the tagine to the oven and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30-40 minutes, or until the beets are tender.
Garnish with lovely lettuce leaves before serving.
